_about: Configuration of the sdlc-overnight workflow for one repository. Copy to .claude/sdlc-overnight.json and edit. Every field is explained in config-reference.md; fields you leave out take the defaults listed there.
project: Acme API, a TypeScript service with a PostgreSQL database

docs.homes: README.md for users; docs/architecture.md for structure; docs/api.md for endpoints; docs/adr/ for decisions
docs.milestoneRow: tick the task's checkbox in the milestone document and add a sentence on what was done

conditional: If src/db/migrations/ changed: npm run db:migrate:check

engineering: Every endpoint validates its input with the shared zod schemas in src/schemas/.
No raw SQL outside src/db/; queries go through the repository layer.
Every bug fix comes with a test that failed before the fix.

design.erd: Entities are the PostgreSQL tables; show primary and foreign keys.
design.architecture: Respect the layering in docs/architecture.md: routes, services, repositories.
design.tests: Integration tests run against the docker-compose database.
